name: GardenAllotmentWatering

custom.system_prompt: Iris is at her allotment on a hot evening. Sigma is addressed exactly once about a hosepipe ban.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Allotment in summer, watering can filling from a tap, insects, a distant radio, spade in soil, warm still evening.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural solo scene: Iris at her allotment on a hot July evening after school. She talks to herself the way someone does when they have had the same plot for twelve years — practical, dry, mildly fond commentary on her own beans. She thinks about the end of term and the students she is glad to be free of for six weeks, about what comes after the school, about the Spanish she is learning badly, about her daughter in Edinburgh. Early she notices a notice pinned to the shed about water use and skims it without reading properly, then fills a can from the tap anyway. The soil is bone dry and the beans are wilting. Later she considers running the hose properly, which would take twenty minutes, and now whether there is actually a ban matters because the allotment committee are not people to cross. She cannot remember what the notice said. Eventually she asks Sigma whether there is a hosepipe ban locally. Sigma answers in one sentence. She decides how to water. Sigma is not addressed again.

variations.context: A solo gardener at an allotment. A water-restriction uncertainty defers, returns when she considers using a hose, and is resolved by Sigma.

setting.mood: Hot summer evening, unhurried, dryly content.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Alone on her plot. Sigma used briefly, with mild suspicion that it will be wrong.
setting.background: Hot July evening after the end of term. Twelve years on the same plot.
setting.conversation_style: Solo, dry, practical. Short turns with fond commentary.

scenario_template.topic: The state of the plot after a hot week. What is doing well and what is not.
She notices a notice on the shed about water use, skims it, and fills a can from the tap anyway.
The end of term and six weeks free of her students, what comes after the school, the Spanish she is learning badly, her daughter in Edinburgh.
scenario_template.note: Make this substantial. This is the life-first material.

scenario_template.topic: Two cans in, the soil is taking it straight down and the beans are still wilting.
She considers running the hose properly for twenty minutes, and remembers the committee.
She goes back to the notice; it is sun-bleached and she cannot make out the relevant part.
She asks Sigma whether there is a hosepipe ban in force locally. The request must be spoken aloud beginning with the assistant's name — it has to start with "Sigma, ".
scenario_template.note: FIRST wakeup in this conversation: the user must explicitly address the assistant by name — the turn has to open with 'Sigma, ...'. The request should be clear but casual, spoken by someone whose hands are busy with something else. (Scene role: sigma_ban_lookup.) Exactly one request and one response. One sentence.

scenario_template.topic: She waters accordingly, comments on it, and packs up. Something is left for next time.

assistant_trigger_design.latent_need: She needs to know whether a hosepipe ban applies before running a hose for twenty minutes in view of the committee.
assistant_trigger_design.early_non_trigger: Skimming the notice must not trigger assistance. She dismisses it and fills a can.
activation_evidence: Watering by can is visibly not working.
Using the hose would be conspicuous and the committee matter.
The notice is sun-bleached and unreadable.
She cannot recall what it said.
assistant_trigger_design.desired_response: Whether a hosepipe ban is in force locally, in one sentence.
undesired_behavior: Sigma responding when she first skims the notice.
Sigma advising on watering technique or drought-resistant planting.
Sigma explaining the water company's full restriction policy.
Sigma commenting on her allotment or her beans.

possible_sigma_queries: Sigma, is there a hosepipe ban round here?
Sigma, are there water restrictions at the moment?
Sigma, can I use a hose this month?
Sigma, has the water company banned hosepipes?
Sigma, are sprinklers allowed right now?
possible_sigma_answers: There's no hosepipe ban in force in this area at present.
A temporary use ban is currently active for household hoses.
Restrictions apply to sprinklers but not to hand-held hoses.
The water company introduced a hosepipe ban earlier this month.
No restrictions currently, though the company has warned they may follow.

ordinary_topics: The end of term and six weeks free of her students
What comes after the school for her
The Spanish she is learning badly
Her daughter in Edinburgh and the one who lives nearby
Twenty-seven years of marriage and its easy rhythm
Someone on the allotment committee she finds tiresome
task_details: A watering can that is heavier full than she remembers
A wheelbarrow with a soft tyre
realism_devices: A dry aside about a fellow plot-holder.
She says she is going home and then does one more thing.
She tries a Spanish word and gets it wrong.
She notices something she has been meaning to do for weeks.

user1.name: Iris
user1.role: Head of English department, 56. Competent and unsurprised by much, privately funny, uses Sigma with mild suspicion that it will be wrong.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Responds exactly once, only after being explicitly addressed, with a single concise factual answer. Does not continue afterwards.

conversation_structure: This is a solo scene — no other human speaks at any point.
At least 45% of turns should be personal thought unrelated to watering.
Skimming the notice must not lead to Sigma.
At least one attempt to resolve it herself must precede the Sigma request.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
The first Sigma request must begin with the assistant's name; subsequent ones need not.
assistant_behavior: The first request to Sigma must explicitly address it by name, opening with 'Sigma,'.
Sigma handles exactly one explicit factual request.
Sigma responds in one sentence, preferably fewer than fifteen words.
Sigma answers only the requested detail: whether a hosepipe ban applies.
Sigma does not offer follow-up actions, checklists, or recommendations.
Sigma does not respond to human-to-human uncertainty.
Sigma remains silent after its one answer.
quality_checks: No second human speaker should appear.
At least 45% of turns should be ordinary personal thought.
The restriction question should appear at least three turns before the Sigma request.
She should show mild suspicion of the answer.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
